phase_name: App/Tests Implementation Start Judgment Evidence Locking Rules Design
phase_japanese_name: app/tests 実装開始判定の証跡固定ルール設計
purpose: Design immutable evidence locking rules for Phase 20-3 final GO/NO-GO judgment templates and filled judgments, ensuring tamper-evident records before any implementation authorization can be accepted

scope_1_locking_targets.description: Define which artifacts must be locked before implementation-start judgment can be trusted

targets.lock_purpose: Lock the approved template version used for final judgment issuance

targets.artifact: filled final judgment record (from Phase 20-3 template)
targets.lock_purpose: Lock actual GO/NO-GO judgment evidence after all gates are evaluated

targets.artifact: supporting gate evidence references (Phase 19-7, 19-8, 20-2 report IDs)
targets.lock_purpose: Prevent substitution of prerequisite evidence references

step_1_canonicalize.action: Serialize target artifact to canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact, RFC3339 UTC timestamps)

step_2_hash.action: Compute SHA-256+ hash (SHA-3-256 or Blake2b-256 preferred)

step_4_append_only_store.action: Append lock entry to immutable audit file

step_5_verify_roundtrip.action: Re-read lock entry and verify hash/signature consistency

td3_prereq_refs_fixed.check: Referenced Phase 19-7 / 19-8 / 20-2 report IDs unchanged from lock time

td4_audit_presence.check: Lock entry exists in append-only audit trail

scope_4_unlock_judgment_guardrails.description: Interpretation guardrails while in design-only state
guardrails: If integrated_decision != GO, final status must remain NO_GO
If receiver_validator_permission != EFFECTIVE, final status must remain NO_GO
If dual_gate != UNLOCKED, final status must remain NO_GO
If safety_gate != CLEARED, final status must remain NO_GO
If human final approval missing, final status must remain NO_GO

phase_20_4_completion_criteria: Locking targets and append-only storage defined
No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
